name: usajobs-mcp
description: USAJOBS (jobs): me, search, get_posting. Every tool maps to a documented endpoint.

platform_mcp_usajobs_api_key.title: PLATFORM_MCP_USAJOBS_API_KEY
platform_mcp_usajobs_api_key.description: USAJOBS API key requested on https://developer.usajobs.gov/ (free); sent as the Authorization-Key header on every call.

platform_mcp_usajobs_email.title: PLATFORM_MCP_USAJOBS_EMAIL
platform_mcp_usajobs_email.description: The e-mail address registered with the API key; USAJOBS requires it as the User-Agent header on every call.

tools.name: me
tools.description: Verified with a one-result search (USAJOBS has no account endpoint).

tools.name: search
tools.description: Federal announcements only. ResultsPerPage ≤ 500 and at most 10,000 rows per query. description carries QualificationSummary; PositionRemuneration, ApplyURI and UserArea.Details stay in raw. No published per-second limit.

tools.name: get_posting
tools.description: Looks the announcement up with the documented PositionID search parameter (there is no per-id path).
